unique_issues.body: 哎呀，新面孔！你是刚来医院的医生吧？
欢迎欢迎！我是飯村真奈美，药剂师。以后请多关照啦！
呵呵，你这是在关心我，还是想打听我们药房会不会拖累你们外科的效率呀？
这样呀。那坂口医生倒是挺会关心人的嘛。
其实我们这里和普通医院的门诊药房不太一样。门诊直接配出去的药不算特别多，主要忙的是住院患者，还有大型治疗和手术的用药。
那当然啦。术前用药、麻醉相关的药物、术中需要的东西，还有术后的镇痛……你们外科只要一忙起来，我们这里就闲不住。
不过先说好哦。你负责开，我负责在你开得太离谱时拦住你。
说起来，你们外科的麻醉安排还真有意思耶。
全麻、局麻，有时候甚至不用麻醉……感觉最后都是主刀医生一句话决定的嘛。
呵呵，没什么呀。就是你们主刀医生的决定，我们药房经常要跟着忙得团团转。
不过我还挺好奇的。同一种手术，患者清醒和睡着的时候，体验究竟会差多少呢？
其实我最近也在研究镇痛方面的东西呢。
现在还早啦，只是一些研究方向。特别是患者保持清醒的时候，有没有办法让整个过程不那么难受。
说不定哪一天，真的能给坂口医生的手术帮上大忙哦！
哎呀，还是让护士来我这里拿药就好啦。手术室什么的，我现在还不太敢进去呢。
当然有啦！我可是专门为了不用整天站在手术台边，才跑来做药剂师的耶！
所以啊，手术就拜托坂口医生，药的事情就交给我吧！

Do you want to experience this too?
Oh, a new face! You must be a doctor who just joined the hospital, right?
Welcome, welcome! I'm Manami Iimura, the pharmacist. I look forward to working with you!
Hehe, are you asking because you care about me, or are you checking whether our pharmacy slows down your surgery department?
I see. Dr. Sakaguchi is quite thoughtful, then.

Actually, we're a little different from an ordinary hospital's outpatient pharmacy. We don't dispense all that many prescriptions directly to outpatients. Most of our work is for inpatients, major treatments, and surgeries.
You bet. Preoperative medication, anesthesia-related drugs, things needed during surgery, and pain relief afterward... Once surgery gets busy, we don't get a moment's rest over here.
But let me make one thing clear. You're in charge of operating, and I'm in charge of stopping you when you operate way out of line.
By the way, your surgery department's anesthesia arrangements are pretty interesting.
General anesthesia, local anesthesia, sometimes no anesthesia at all... In the end, it feels like the surgeon-in-charge decides everything with a single word.
Hehe, not really. It's just that when you surgeons make a decision, our pharmacy often ends up rushing around to keep up.
But I am curious. For the same surgery, how different is the experience for a patient who's awake versus asleep?
Actually, I've been researching pain relief lately, too.
It's too early for that; I'm only exploring a few research directions. Especially when a patient stays awake, I wonder if there's a way to make the whole process less unpleasant.
Maybe one day I really will be able to help with one of your surgeries, Dr. Sakaguchi!
Oh, I'd rather have the nurses come here to pick up their medications. The operating room... I'm not quite brave enough to go in there yet.
Of course! I became a pharmacist specifically so I wouldn't have to stand beside an operating table all day!
So, I'll leave the surgery to you, Dr. Sakaguchi, and the medication to me!
